editorial:
Imagine growing up in a place that feels like it is falling apart around you. You follow Enea and his best friend Valentino, two young guys just trying to survive a corrupt world. They spend their time partying and dealing drugs, but there is something deeper going on here. It is not just about the crime; it is about two friends who want to feel alive when everything else feels dead. You will feel the energy of their friendship and the sadness of their family lives, like Enea's struggling parents and his brother. It feels like a wild ride through youth where the characters are fighting against a system that wants to keep them down.

The acting is top-notch and makes you really care about these boys. The movie moves well, though some parts feel a bit slow because of the heavy family drama. If you like stories about loyalty and breaking the rules, you will love this. You should definitely watch this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the beautiful scenery, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great call because the visuals are just that good.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a mix of sadness and hope. After all the trouble with the underworld and their family pain, Enea finally finds a way to break free from his cycle of misery. The ending shows him moving toward a new beginning, leaving the darkness of his past behind. While some things end in tragedy, like the loss of innocence, he finds peace and a sense of freedom that he had been chasing since the start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship and overcoming hard times.
